findings.title: Direct LLM API calls bypass model router in emergency alert handler

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini and call_mistral using raw environment variables instead of dispatching to model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert intelligence calls to route through model router client

findings.expected_benefit: Centralized observability, rate limit enforcement, and automated fallback for emergency intelligence queries

findings.title: Model router call log file is missing despite active failures

evidence.observation: Router status indicates 5 recent failed requests, but configured log_file at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl does not exist

proposed_action.description: Verify model router logging configuration and ensure call_log.jsonl is created with appropriate directory permissions

findings.expected_benefit: Enables latency tracking, error diagnostics, and auditability for LLM routing decisions
